A340E(Others) AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION - COMPONENT PARTS INSTALLATION

38. INSTALL SPEEDOMETER DRIVE GEAR AND BALL SUPRA:

Q00627

OTHERS:
(a) Install the lock ball on the output shaft.
(b) Align the groove of the drive gear with the ball, install the drive gear.

AT8248

SUPRA:
(c) Using snap ring pliers, install the snap ring.

Q00628

OTHERS:

AT8217

39. INSTALL EXTENSION HOUSING AND NEW GASKET
(a) Install the oil apply tube and a new gasket to the extension housing.
(b) Install the oil apply tube and a new gasket to the extension housing.

AT4637
